INSERT INTO chat_message (company_id, chat_message_id, chat_room_id, sender_employee_id, message_type, message_text, attachment_id, client_message_key, created_at) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{chatMessageId}, #{chatRoomId}, #{senderEmployeeId}, #{messageType}, #{messageText,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{attachmentId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{clientMessageKey}, default)
mapper.select: SELECT r.chat_room_id, r.room_type, CASE WHEN r.room_type = 'ROOM_DIRECT' THEN e.employee_name ELSE r.room_name END AS display_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message msg WHERE msg.company_id = m.company_id AND msg.chat_room_id = m.chat_room_id AND msg.sender_employee_id != m.employee_id AND msg.chat_message_id > NVL(m.last_read_message_id, 0)) AS unread_count, lm.message_type AS last_message_type, SUBSTR(lm.message_text, 1, 100) AS last_message_text, lm.created_at AS last_message_at, CASE WHEN lm.sender_employee_id = m.employee_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS last_message_mine FROM chat_room r JOIN chat_member m ON m.company_id = r.company_id AND m.chat_room_id = r.chat_room_id LEFT JOIN employee e ON r.room_type = 'ROOM_DIRECT' AND e.company_id = r.company_id AND e.employee_id = CASE WHEN r.direct_employee_low = m.employee_id THEN r.direct_employee_high ELSE r.direct_employee_low END OUTER APPLY ( SELECT x.message_type, x.message_text, x.created_at, x.sender_employee_id FROM chat_message x WHERE x.company_id = r.company_id AND x.chat_room_id = r.chat_room_id ORDER BY x.chat_message_id DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ) lm WHERE m.company_id = #{companyId} AND m.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND m.left_at IS NULL ORDER BY COALESCE(lm.created_at, r.created_at) DESC, r.chat_room_id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_member member JOIN chat_message msg ON msg.company_id = member.company_id AND msg.chat_room_id = member.chat_room_id WHERE member.company_id = #{companyId} AND member.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND member.left_at IS NULL AND msg.sender_employee_id != #{employeeId} AND msg.chat_message_id > NVL(member.last_read_message_id, 0)

SELECT NVL(MAX(member.last_read_message_id), 0) FROM chat_room room JOIN chat_member member ON member.company_id = room.company_id AND member.chat_room_id = room.chat_room_id WHERE room.company_id = #{companyId} AND room.chat_room_id = #{roomId} AND room.room_type = 'ROOM_DIRECT' AND member.employee_id = CASE WHEN room.direct_employee_low = #{employeeId} THEN room.direct_employee_high ELSE room.direct_employee_low END AND member.left_at IS NULL
